item.title: Room-temperature correlated microwaves from magnons
item.description:
📚 Nature Electronics
👤 Xufeng Zhang
Nature Electronics, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41928-026-01703-3 A tiny magnetic film placed atop a microwave circuit can be used to create a compact source of correlated microwave signals that operates at room temperature.

item.title: 亚铁磁 Mn2CrO4 的电子结构研究
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该工作围绕亚铁磁化合物 Mn2CrO4 的电子结构展开研究。题目表明其重点在于分析该材料的能带、磁性电子态及其与亚铁磁行为之间的关系，具体结论需结合原文进一步确认。

item.title: Textured Si Wafer-Assisted Fabrication of Stretchable Platinum Nanotube Network Electrodes for Flexible Piezoelectric Devices
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Hee Yeon Jeon, Jeong Hyun Kim, Kyung-Shik Yoon, Hyeon Seong Kim, Jae Min Park, Kwanlae Kim 等8位作者
Flexible and stretchable electrodes are essential components for soft electronic devices that operate under repeated mechanical deformation. However, conventional metal thin-film electrodes often suffer from crack formation and electrical failure because of the mechanical mismatch between rigid metal layers and elastomeric substrates. In this study, we present a textured Si-assisted fabrication strategy for stretchable platinum nanotube (Pt-NT) network electrodes. Electrospun polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) nanofibers on a textured Si wafer were used as sacrificial one-dimensional templates for Pt sputtering, enabling the formation of Pt-coated fibrous networks with controlled electrical continuity. item.title: Physics-informed symbolic regression reveals a delayed oscillatory closure for particle–interface dynamics
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Teddy Lazebnik, Chen Mortenfeld and Alex Liberzon
Particles settling through sharply density-stratified fluids exhibit transient dynamics that remain difficult to capture with classical buoyancy–drag models, including strong deceleration, prolonged retention near the interface, and, in some cases, apparent bouncing. Existing mechanistic models that reproduce parts of this behavior through the equation of motion rely on auxiliary artificial virtual-mass ODEs whose physical interpretation and predictive generality are limited. In this study, we demonstrate implementation of physics-informed symbolic regression (PISR) method, applied to high-resolution dataset of particle-tracking experiments across stratified interface, enabling a compact analytical closure for the delayed stratification-induced force acting on spheres crossing sharp densi…

item.title: A cascaded random access quantum memory
item.description:
📚 Nature Physics
👤 Ziqian Li, Eesh Gupta, Fang Zhao, Riju Banerjee, Yao Lu, Tanay Roy 等10位作者
Nature Physics, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03418-w Random access memory is an important element of classical computers, but equivalent schemes for quantum computers are much less mature. Now an eight-qubit random access memory has been demonstrated using superconducting circuits.

item.title: An all-electric on-chip nanoplasma pulse generator for picosecond field-free spin–orbit torque switching in magnetic heterostructures

item.title: Structured light–matter interaction in semiconductor cavity quantum electrodynamics

Nature Nanotechnology, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41565-026-02275-1 Structured light–matter interaction at the single-photon level is demonstrated in a coupled quantum-dot–micropillar system, enabling cavity-enhanced single-photon emission with spin-locked orbital angular momentum and tunable spin–orbit entanglement.

item.title: 峨眉山大火成岩省单晶古强度记录揭示的晚二叠世地核—地表—磁层状态
item.description:
📚 Nature Communications
👤 Wentao Huang, John A. Tarduno, Zhenyu Yang, Richard K. Bono, Wenbin Tang, Yuntao Tian 等10位作者
研究利用约 2.6 亿年前辉长岩中斜长石保存的磁记录重建古地磁场强度。结果显示，地球磁场曾突然降至现今的一半，但仍不足以造成臭氧显著耗竭或直接驱动晚二叠世灭绝事件。

item.title: Superfluid qubit could help scale up quantum computers
item.description:
📚 Physics News
Superfluid helium could offer a new way to tackle one of the biggest challenges in scaling up quantum computers, say researchers from the University of Surrey. The research team has introduced a conceptual design for a new type of qubit that could be much less vulnerable to errors.

item.title: 一种计算永磁同步电机永磁体厚度的新方法
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Duan weichuan, Li Ming, Lun Shuxian
针对永磁同步电机永磁体厚度经验公式精度不足、有限元参数扫描耗时的问题，作者提出一种基于有限元初值模型的迭代计算方法：提取漏磁系数、磁阻率和平均气隙磁密后迭代更新厚度。以1600 kW、250 r/min U形内置式永磁同步电机验证，该方法较有限元参数扫描节省约75%计算时间且得到相同厚度结果。电磁性能分析和样机试验表明，该方法可在不牺牲精度的前提下提高设计效率。

item.title: 巴西改造型社会住房的空间构型：设计模式的关系分析
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Eduardo Reuter Schneck, Andrea Parisi Kern, Vinicius M. Netto
该文研究巴西中心城区闲置建筑改造为社会住房的空间与设计特征，基于Christopher Alexander的设计模式理论构建关系化分析框架。作者不是孤立考察模式，而是通过共现关系、拓扑表现和中心性指标分析十个改造项目中的模式组合结构，并结合建筑资料与现场调研。结果显示，样本中存在强连接的设计核心及具有衔接作用的关键模式，为理解改造型社会住房的空间质量提供了网络化证据。

item.title: 拉伸下纳米多孔碳的微观力学演化：机器学习分子动力学研究
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该研究题目表明作者结合机器学习势函数与分子动力学，考察纳米多孔碳在拉伸载荷下的微观力学响应。重点应包括孔结构演化、应力传递与失效机制，以揭示多孔碳在拉伸过程中的结构—性能关系。

item.title: Geospatial Assessment of Urban Growth Patterns and Its Impact on Land Surface Temperature
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Sonia Anwar, Waheed Ullah Khan, Noor Un Nisa
The rapid urbanization strongly influences the land surface characteristics and aggravates the environmental problems, such as Surface Urban Heat Island (SUHI) effect. The present study focuses on the effect of urban growth pattern on Land Surface Temperature (LST) and precipitation variability in Dera Ghazi Khan, Punjab, Pakistan during 25 years, 2000-2025. The study combines the use of Remote Sensing (RS), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Google Earth Engine (GEE), and statistical modeling to analyze the temporal and spatial associations of Land Use/Land Cover (LULC) alteration with the thermal environment. The multi-temporal data from Landsat missions and Sentinel-2 datasets was used to categorize the study area into four major classes of LULC namely Water Body, Built-up, Agricult…

item.title: 面向杂化钙钛矿 HSE06 带隙预测的高效且经校准的 Δ 学习
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该文题目表明研究聚焦于杂化钙钛矿体系中 HSE06 带隙的机器学习预测，并强调数据效率与校准能力。其核心应是通过 Δ-learning 在较少高精度数据条件下提升预测精度，同时给出更可靠的不确定性控制。

item.title: 从预制造到部署后：面向集成电路逻辑锁定的统一机器学习驱动流程
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Nahush Tambe, Fareena Saqib
该文提出覆盖集成电路保护全生命周期的四阶段机器学习驱动逻辑锁定流程，以应对技术选择依赖人工、静态密钥门易受攻击以及部署后安全不足等问题。流程首先用随机森林从门级网表提取结构特征，在五类经典锁定方案中预测合适技术，最高预测准确率达97%。随后通过故障引导密钥门插入或基于轻量级流密码的STREAMLOCK实现保护，后者以持续演化密钥流削弱固定密钥—输出关系被oracle引导和结构攻击利用的风险。

item.title: 基于机器视觉与深度学习的蛋壳表面微污染物快速无损识别
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Yu Hu¹, Rongchen Zhang¹, Binyan Hou¹, Xingbiao Huang², Tong Sun¹
针对蛋壳表面微小污染物尺寸小、对比度低且背景纹理复杂导致漏检和误检的问题，研究提出一种改进YOLOv8s检测方法。数据预处理采用ROI提取和背景归一化以抑制传送带纹理及环境噪声，并增强污染区域显著性；网络结构引入AIFI模块、EMA注意力机制和融合P2层的四尺度检测架构。结果表明，该方法能有效降低复杂背景干扰，提高微污染目标的可分辨性和检测稳定性。

item.title: 动态热激励下锂离子电池SOC估计的热关系状态推断方法
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Yicheng Li, Hui Zeng, Jiayan Xia, Yaqing Shi, Pin Liu
该研究针对动态热条件下端电测量与隐含荷电状态关系随时间变化的问题，提出热关系状态推断网络TRSI-Net，将SOC估计表述为受热状态调制的关系推断。模型通过热条件仿射重校准、热关系场、热关系记忆注意力和全局关系读出，显式建模温度演化对历史样本两两相关性的影响。在Panasonic NCR18650PF数据集上，TRSI-Net取得MAE 0.47%、RMSE 0.56%、R² 99.94%，相对基线显著降低误差。

item.title: A new game demonstrates quantum advantage with provable classical limits
item.description:
📚 Physics News
For decades, physicists have worked to prove the strange predictions of quantum mechanics with real experiments. As quantum computers have grown more powerful, researchers have devised increasingly sophisticated ways to test whether these machines are truly harnessing quantum effects—but every method so far has run into limits.

item.title: A Novel Material Nano-Scale Material Derived from Garlic Shell Integrated with Red Meat Samples
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Zafer Ceylan, Abdullah Demirci, Mehmet Cengiz Karaismailoğlu
The study aimed to develop a novel garlic-shell-based nanofiber using electrospinning and to evaluate its effectiveness in enhancing the safety and shelf life of red meat coated with the fabricated nanofibers. The fabricated nanofibers (71.869 ± 52.830 nm) were characterized by Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Fourier Transform Infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, and Thermogravimetric Analysis (TGA). FTIR spectra of the fabricated nanofibers revealed a chemical structure featuring hydroxyl, aliphatic, and carbonyl groups, alongside active sulphur compounds such as allicin. The thermal mass loss of the obtained nanofibers was not significant at the cooking temperature of red meat samples.
